definitions.explanation: The hard outer covering of a shellfish or mollusk. Often found on beaches and collected as souvenirs or decorations.

examples.japanese: {貝殻|かいがら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧な{貝殻|かいがら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I found a beautiful seashell on the beach.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{貝殻|かいがら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拾|ひろ}って→拾う：00845_hirou⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: The children are playing picking up seashells.

notes:
{貝殻|かいがら} is the hard outer covering left behind by mollusks and other shellfish. Seashells washed up on beaches are a common sight in Japan, and {貝殻|かいがら}{拾|ひろ}い (shell collecting) is a popular seaside activity for children and adults alike.

- ⟦{貝|かい}→貝：02145_kai⟧ (shellfish) + {殻|がら} (shell, husk)

- {貝殻|かいがら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧ (to collect seashells)
